description: SportsDataverse Python package: load_* readers for released sports datasets and wrappers for ESPN, stats.nba.com, Baseball Savant, NHL and other APIs, returning polars DataFrames.
rules: Import functions from the league submodule, e.g. `from sportsdataverse.nba import espn_nba_team_roster`.
Functions return a polars DataFrame by default; pass `return_as_pandas=True` to get pandas.
For historical data prefer the `load_<league>_*` loaders, which read pre-built datasets from sportsdataverse-data GitHub releases; most take `seasons` (an int or a list of ints).
Live-API wrappers (`espn_<league>_*`, `nba_stats_*`, `mlb_statcast_*`) return tidy frames by default; pass `return_parsed=False` for the raw JSON payload.
`NoDataError` means the request succeeded and there is no data; `AssetFetchError` means the request failed (403, rate limit, retries exhausted). Both live in `sportsdataverse.errors`.
`nba_stats_*` and `wnba_stats_*` need `curl_cffi` (`pip install sportsdataverse[all]`); stats.nba.com often hangs from cloud or datacenter IPs.
